findings.current: The Prophet meets the hidden Hasasin in a desert, using an undetectable transparent barrier to conceal their base and displaying a hoard of Magic Gems and enchanted weapons. He absorbs ten unrefined S-rank Magic Gems and orders Al-Nizar and the Hasasin to prepare another judgment against apostates and Western heretics.
findings.defect: The summary introduces two unsupported certainties: the concealed area is not established as the Hasasin’s base, and the Prophet draws the Magic Gems into the robe rather than explicitly absorbing them.
findings.rationale: This preserves the actions shown in Chapter 745 without assigning an unconfirmed function to the location or an unconfirmed mechanism to the Magic Gems.
findings.replacement: The Prophet meets the hidden Hasasin in a desert, surrounds the meeting area with a transparent barrier undetectable by science or Magic, and reveals a hoard of Magic Gems and enchanted weapons. He draws ten unrefined S-rank Magic Gems into his robe and orders Al-Nizar and the Hasasin to prepare another judgment against apostates and Western heretics.

findings.current: Jin reaches Leviathan and uses One Annihilation, destroying its teeth, half its maw, and one eye, but suffering catastrophic recoil and acquiring the potentially permanent Broken Body debuff. A Top-Grade Potion removes his other conditions but cannot heal Broken Body or restore the lost combat attributes.
findings.defect: Broken Body is not identified as potentially permanent; the possible permanent consequence is attribute loss during recovery. The combat attributes are currently reduced by 50 points rather than already lost.
findings.rationale: Chapter 749 distinguishes the active debuff, its temporary 50-point penalty, and the separate risk of permanent attribute loss during recovery.
findings.replacement: Jin reaches Leviathan and uses One Annihilation, shattering its teeth and tearing away half its maw and one eye, but suffering catastrophic recoil and acquiring the Broken Body debuff. A Top-Grade Potion removes his other conditions but cannot remove Broken Body; while the debuff remains active, his combat-related attributes are reduced by 50 points, and recovery may permanently cost him some attributes.

findings.current: His combat-related attributes are reduced by 50%, and recovery may involve permanent attribute loss.
findings.defect: The percentage sign changes the System mechanic: the panel specifies a decrease of 50, reinforced by the individual Strength decrease of 50.
findings.rationale: The replacement matches the numerical mechanic shown in Chapter 749 and avoids carrying an incorrect percentage into future continuity.
findings.replacement: His combat-related attributes are reduced by 50 points, and recovery may involve permanent attribute loss.

findings.current: The Water Rescue Worker Title lasts twenty-four hours but is 20% less effective because of its incompatibility with Scorching Yang Qi.
findings.defect: The reading copy says the incompatibility reduces all of Jin’s power by 20%, not merely the effectiveness of the Title.
findings.rationale: This preserves the scope of the stated drawback instead of narrowing it to the Title’s effects.
findings.replacement: The Water Rescue Worker Title lasts twenty-four hours, but because it clashes with Scorching Yang Qi, all Jin’s power is reduced by 20%.
